fixture.writeMethod: synthetic prepared SQL in one bulk transaction; not production write-path performance

measurementNotes: Query latency includes queued worker dispatch, real Repository::queryHistory SQL/step loading and delivery to the main event loop.
Synthetic fixture generation and schema initialization are excluded from query latency and timer gap samples.
Main-thread QCoreApplication timer gaps are an event-loop responsiveness proxy; no GUI rendering is measured.
OS file cache may be warm after fixture generation; these are not cold-cache or long-duration stability measurements.
Exactly one query is outstanding; no queue-peak or high-concurrency claim is made.

processMemory.scope: whole benchmark process, including fixture generation
